generator: project-authored host Python tool, no external puzzle corpus
generation_session: initial serial sampler interrupted; accepted checkpoint continued with deterministic seeded host worker batches
reproducibility: exact delivered grids/solutions/proofs retained; fresh single-phase regeneration is not claimed byte-identical to this resumed session
stable_ids: canonical SHA256 first 32 bits; collision check required; full canonical SHA256 retained in host JSON
image_generation: built-in image_gen; prompts and generated originals in sources/
postprocessing: user-requested PNG extraction, pixel dimensions, 16-gray quantization and deterministic UI composition
scope: design assets and host bank tool, not firmware support or panel acceptance
